newsitem.title: UK: Sterling pares gains from highs vs dollar, mark.
newsitem.headline: Sterling pares gains from highs vs dollar, mark.

text.p: 0705 GMT - Stg/mark trading a pfennig off Thursday's near-6-year high of 2.9620. Cable pares gains after reaching $1.6929 yesterday, its best showing since January 10.
* Stg/mark last at 2.9525/35 vs 2.9580/90 late Thursday in Europe. Cable at $1.6868/78 vs $1.6900/10 yesterday.
* Stg hit by profit-taking after hitting peaks Thursday but expectations of UK rate rise next week seen limiting losses.
* UK monetary policy committee meets July 9-10. Economists polled by Reuters expect rates to rise to 6.75 pct from current 6.5 pct.
